records.name: Ashwa
records.tagline: Your AI companion that never forgets what you say
records.description: Come back after 100 days, and Ashwa can still recall relevant details from your past conversations and diary entries. Pick up where you left off without repeating your story. Talk through your day, reflect in a private daily journal, and get responses shaped by the emotional context you've shared

records.name: Omi Work
records.tagline: Omi can build anything. Now it finds your next 100 customers
records.description: Omi can build anything. Omi Work is an AI workspace for the hardest, longest jobs. Give it a goal: it shows the plan first, splits big work across sub-agents, searches the web, uses the apps you connect, keeps going after you close the tab, and hands back documents, sheets with formulas and slide decks. Ready-made teammates, scheduled tasks and voice mode. Teams get roles, SSO and an audit log. Free to start, no card.

records.name: naturefunding.org
records.tagline: Grants for nature projects, checked against funder pages
records.description: A free directory of 1,000+ grants for nature restoration and conservation: forests, coasts, wetlands, wildlife and more. Every deadline, amount and eligibility rule links to the funder's own page, with its exact words and the date we checked it. Filter by place, deadline, who can apply and how to apply (directly, through a partner, or invitation only). No paid listings, no sign-up. Data is open (CC BY 4.0) as JSON, CSV and an Atom feed.

records.name: Plango
records.tagline: Plango lets your AI agents work all night - safely
records.description: AI is wreaking havoc in cybersecurity. You need a command center to protect your device and AI-agent setup. There are two major risks today: 1. External AI attackers finding exploits 2. Internal AI taking unsafe actions Plango researches and patches vulnerabilities while running entirely on-device. It finds where you're vulnerable and shows how to fix it. (example: you may be vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks due to SSL certs compromised in October. Plango shows if you have them!)

records.name: Gauth Personal Study Agent
records.tagline: An AI study agent that remembers where you struggle
records.description: Gauth Personal Study Agent connects the questions you snap, the quizzes you take, and the topics you study into one ongoing picture of how you learn. Instead of starting from scratch each session, it spots the gap behind a mistake, builds a short daily plan around it, and adjusts that plan when you miss a review or master a topic early. Practice comes as flashcards, guided step-by-step walkthroughs, and quizzes, with topic mastery and streaks to show progress. Built into the Gauth app.

records.name: Modem
records.tagline: Find, fix, and follow up on every customer concern
records.description: Modem monitors your customer channels (support tickets, group chat, sales calls) and alerts you to problems within minutes. It can automatically open an issue, spin up a coding agent, or escalate to the right team. When the fix ships, it closes the loop with your customers. Never lose track of a request again.

records.name: Letter Visitors
records.tagline: See website visitors on your website itself
records.description: Know who’s on your website: the people, their companies, and the AI agents reading your pages. See them on your own site, and replay their sessions.

records.name: Inkling 2 Mini
records.tagline: 26B looped model for coding on your laptop
records.description: Inkling 2 Mini is Thinking Machines' 26.4B open-weight model built for local agentic work. Its middle transformer layers run three times per token, adding reasoning depth without extra weights. It runs on 32GB Macs through Ollama.

records.name: MAI Image 2.7
records.tagline: Microsoft's image model with precise edits and Canvas
records.description: MAI Image 2.7 and MAI Image 2.7 Flash are Microsoft AI's image generation and editing models. They change an object's color, material or position without disturbing the rest, and output transparent backgrounds for logos and product images. Canvas, powered by Flash, turns prompts and sketches into editable images. Per Microsoft, 2.7 ranks #1 on Artificial Analysis image editing. Public preview on Foundry at about $35 and $10 per 1,000 images.

records.name: Spikely
records.tagline: Startup Metric Alerts for iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch
records.description: Spikely watches Stripe, Vercel, PostHog and 16 more tools, learns what’s normal for every number, and alerts you the minute one breaks pattern, with the deploy, error or referrer behind it. Every startup’s sales, live in one app.

records.name: Branchery
records.tagline: Branchery, a Git client for Mac
records.description: Branchery is a Git client for Macs with Apple Silicon. It handles very large repositories, works offline and has no telemetry. Free for public repositories.

records.name: Journalistic Tech
records.tagline: Async interviews that get you published on HackerNoon
records.description: Tell us what you do or what just happened. We match you to one of 273 technology interviews. Answer ~13 questions by voice or text, on your own time. Your answers become a bylined draft, an editor reviews and polishes it, then it publishes on HackerNoon and gets distributed around the web.

records.name: LeanTake
records.tagline: 4.1 MB native Mac screen recorder — zero export wait
records.description: Pure Swift + ScreenCaptureKit screen recorder for macOS 15+ (Apple Silicon). Real-time hardware encoding writes finishedmov videos the second you hit Stop. Includes a 12-color live pen, region magnifier, 9 3D cat paw cursors, and a window-excluded stealth teleprompter. Free forever (no watermark, no login); optional Pro $14.99 one-time.

records.name: FigmaMCP
records.tagline: Let Claude Code or Codex edit your open Figma file
records.description: A free Mac app and Figma plugin that let Claude Code or Codex read and edit the file open in Figma desktop. No Figma API token, no call quota. The app installs the plugin and connects your agent. One switch makes the file read-only.

records.name: Replit Missions
records.tagline: Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents,
records.description: Turn ambitious goals into outcomes with Replit Missions. Set a budget, coordinate teams of AI agents, and review progress against clear success criteria.

records.name: Open Source Solana Wallet
records.tagline: Your own keys, your very own network
records.description: A Solana wallet for iPhone and iPad with no backend. It connects directly to the RPC you choose: public Solana RPC, a provider with your own key, or any HTTPS URL. - Private balances for SOL, USDC, and USDT - Only the tokens you add, so no spam - Prices in your currency, from the built-in source, your own server, or none - Built-in themes, or build your own theme pack - Several windows on iPad and iPhone Duo - Open source

records.name: Strict
records.tagline: Run GitHub Actions on any spare Mac or Linux machine
records.description: Turn spare Macs and Linux boxes into a self-healing, auto load-balancing GitHub Actions fleet at $0/min compute. Includes a native macOS Liquid Glass app, 7-tier disk cleanup, preflight doctor, and Tailscale-native setup—zero account required.

records.name: Chat with Work
records.tagline: AI bots in Europe. They work. You decide.
records.description: Create a bot with a single sentence. It works for you. Create as many as you need. They start by themselves and work across 1,920+ integrations with your laptop closed. When there's a decision to take, they ask you. Every question and approval from all your bots lands in one place. You just decide. Claude Duet: US only. ChatGPT's dots: not on Pro or Plus in Europe. Gemini's Tasks: not in Europe. Not us. Chat with Work's bots run in the EU, on every plan. 300 trial credits, no card.

records.name: Motionflare
records.tagline: Turn your website into a stunning launch video in minutes
records.description: Motionflare turns your website into a ready-to-share marketing video and brand film in minutes. Paste a URL and it uses your real product screenshots, logo, colors, and copy to create branded motion graphics with music and optional narration. Or switch to Film mode to generate a live-action commercial. Refine the result by chat and export in up to 4K.

records.name: Dog Translator SuperTranslator
records.tagline: Dogs talking in English (real)
records.description: What if your dog could tell you what they're feeling? SuperTranslator uses AI to read your dog's body language, vocalizations and interactions with their surroundings, and turns those signals into plain English. Instead of random phrases from barks, it looks at several behavioral cues at once to help you understand what your dog might be communicating. According to our benchmarks, this is the most accurate dog translation in history.

records.name: Tesla Self-Driving V15
records.tagline: Upgrading every part of the end-to-end driving network
records.description: What's new in FSD V15: • 25x better handling of safety-critical cases • Tesla Reality View: a live generative view from a virtual camera above your car, so you see and control what FSD plans • Fullscreen, map, split or quiet mode • Nav turns in the visualization; quieter turn signals • Trip start/end routing learned from fleet route preferences • Better detection of signs, animals, debris, potholes and standing water; smoother speed in school zones and bad weather

records.name: Orpheus
records.tagline: Run all your Claude subscriptions from one place
records.description: Orpheus puts every Claude subscription you pay for on one board: weekly and 5-hour usage, forecast and reset. Move idle agents to the account with room, answer agents on every machine, and open Rooms where your team and your agents chat together.

records.name: Kopyo
records.tagline: The Mac clipboard manager that remembers everything
records.description: Kopyo is a native macOS clipboard manager. It saves everything you copy (text, links, images, files) and brings it back with ⇧⌘V. Search even finds the text inside screenshots, every clip remembers where it came from, and ⇥ pastes it as original, plain text or Markdown. 53 previewed transforms, a paste queue, pinboards, snippets, a CLI and AppleScript. Secrets are masked, encrypted and deleted within minutes. 7-day free trial, no account needed.

records.name: Hydrilla
records.tagline: Generate production-ready 3D assets with AI
records.description: Hydrilla AI generates high-quality 3D assets from simple prompts. Designed for game developers, animation studios, and XR creators, it helps teams create production-ready models in minutes instead of days. Build faster pipelines for games, films, and immersive worlds.

records.name: Jot
records.tagline: One key for everything you do with text
records.description: Select text in any app, press one key, and Jot fixes it, translates it, summarises it or turns it into a reminder, email or Word file. Search everything you ever copied. Over 70 actions. $14.99 once, no subscription.

records.name: Snowly
records.tagline: Plan ski trips with friends. Remember every run.
records.description: Snowly is a ski and snowboard app for iPhone and Apple Watch. Plan trips with friends, see your crew on the trail map, check the snow before you go, and let Snowly record every run on its own. Each day lands in your ski passport. Free, with no ads.

records.name: Polylane Swarms
records.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
records.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

records.name: freddy
records.tagline: Private health data server: talk to your health with any AI
records.description: freddy is your health data server. Connect your wearables, rings, glucose monitors, training apps, Apple Health and Health Connect once, and add your lab results. freddy keeps every value as the source sends it. Use it with any AI, export it, or build on it.

records.name: Othor AI
records.tagline: Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding
records.description: Othor AI is a new species of business intelligence, built on the tradecraft of intelligence agencies and a century of signal analysis. Automated statistical intelligence for business leaders: more signal, faster decisions, with the smallest possible AI bill and the least human effort. AI drafts the words; code computes every number, and any night can be replayed byte for byte. Open source (Apache-2.0); hosted or on your servers.

records.name: ExtraBar
records.tagline: Build a custom menu bar for your Mac
records.description: Your Mac menu bar fills up with icons you never click, while the things you do every day stay buried in menus. ExtraBar lets you build a menu bar around the apps you actually use.

records.name: Mobile Agent Testers
records.tagline: Free open-source AI agents that beta-test your app on phones
records.description: No test scripts. Each tester is an AI agent with its own Android emulator or iOS Simulator on GitHub Actions, playing a persona: iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size, Pixel 7 at 200%, iPad in German, Arabic right to left. It uses your app like a new user and writes a bug report with screenshots, then one summary groups the duplicates. Open source. Flutter, React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Swift, KMP, Capacitor,NET MAUI, or a prebuilt APK.

records.name: Vision
records.tagline: Open Source AI Business Observability Platform
records.description: Vision unifies product analytics, session replays and LLM token cost attribution into a single open-source platform. Know what your users do, what your AI costs and track true unit economics per user in real time.

records.name: Krepost
records.tagline: You private and secure files vault
records.description: An encrypted, local-first photo and file vault for Android. Files are sealed on the phone, with no account, no cloud storage and no internet permission.

records.name: Operatif
records.tagline: Operator Intelligence for Value Creation
records.description: Operator intelligence for value creation. Matches private equity, venture capital, and enterprise portfolio challenges to vetted operators backed by verified execution evidence.

records.name: AINameCheck
records.tagline: See if ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI recommend your business
records.description: Free check of whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews recommend your business. AINameCheck asks 10 real local questions in your language and shows where you appear and which competitors get recommended instead. An optional $39 kit gives the step-by-step fixes. Built for small and medium businesses worldwide.

records.name: SimpleCVTool
records.tagline: Simply, a CV that reflects you.
records.description: Build a CV that truly reflects you, simply and quickly. Choose from 30 professional templates (including 3 for free), customize your layout with live preview, and use our AI writing assistant to structure your experience without inventing facts. Export a clean, ready-to-send PDF straight from your browser—no software installation required.

records.name: Wish Tree
records.tagline: Friends hang wishes on your tree; you open them on the day
records.description: Wish Tree is a free online wish tree. Make a tree for a birthday, Christmas or any day, share one link, and friends hang a wish with a little hand-painted gift. Friends need no app or account, and every wish stays sealed until midnight on your day.

records.name: UI PATTERNS by ENVY DESIGN
records.tagline: UI patterns with wireframes, live demos and AI prompts
records.description: A free library of 690+ common UI patterns for websites and apps, grouped by component: headers, pricing tables, forms, modals, dashboards and more. Each pattern has PC and mobile wireframes, a live demo you can click through, original design examples, notes on when to use it and common mistakes, and a prompt to build the same structure with AI. Compare options, try them, then decide. English, Japanese and Spanish. No sign-up.

records.name: ChineseFortuneTools
records.tagline: Explore Chinese Zodiac, BaZi & Feng Shui for Free
records.description: ChineseFortuneTools is a collection of free interactive tools that make traditional Chinese culture easier to explore.

records.name: JobMate
records.tagline: Your AI agent for job applications and referrals
records.description: Find matching jobs in the US and India, tailor your resume and let Otto submit supported applications. Coordinate recruiter emails and LinkedIn referral requests, get WhatsApp updates and track confirmed activity. Start with 10 automated applications and 10 recruiter emails free, once. Job matches and job kits stay free.

records.name: EL LEARNERS APP
records.tagline: All-in-one platform for schools to teach, test and manage
records.description: EL LEARNERS APP is the all-in-one smart schooling platform for modern schools. We help schools teach better, test faster, and manage easier — in one flat rate. Built for students, teachers and parents: - Interactive learning hub with live classes - Live CBTs with instant grading for WAEC/NECO/JAMB prep (SSS2/SSS3) - Real-time progress tracking for parents and teachers - Secure, tech-first campus where fees reconcile automatically - ELITES Mentorship Centre access after one academic term

records.name: spentr
records.tagline: Receipt Scanner & Mileage Tracker for Self-Employed
records.description: spentr is an expense and mileage tracker for the self-employed and short-term rental hosts. Snap a receipt and it captures the merchant, date, total and every line item, not just a lump sum. Forward email receipts straight in, let mileage log itself, and track rental hours. Everything sorts into tax categories, so filing means pulling a report instead of rebuilding the year from memory. Ask Spencer, the built-in AI assistant, about your spending. On iPhone, iPad and the web.

records.name: Lorebo
records.tagline: Build a knowledge graph by talking to your AI
records.description: Lorebo is a local-first desktop app backed by a graph database. You and your AI agents work with the same editable notes and sources through built-in MCP. Tell your agent what to keep, review the connected pages in Desktop, and reuse them in a new chat. Explore typed links in 2D, 3D, or Mermaid. Shared rules guide agents to update existing pages. Draw on separate bases in one task, share a base with colleagues, and start with ready-to-install templates. No code required.

records.name: PDF Templates: Notebook Studio
records.tagline: Create digital notebook templates
records.description: Hey Product Hunt! I use an e-ink tablet every day for notes and planning, & I kept running into the same frustration: pre-made PDF planner packs are rigid, bloated with pages you never use, or locked behind recurring subscriptions. Hyperlinked PDFs: Configure page structures, dated calendars, index tabs, and internal links directly on iPhone or iPad. No accounts, no cloud lock-in, and no subscription—just a single $6.99 / £6.99 purchase for unlimited exports whenever your workflow evolves.

records.name: LottoRoll
records.tagline: Lottery number picks with a personal seed
records.description: LottoRoll is a free lottery number generator for 50 games across 17 countries and regions. Choose a game and roll up to five lines, then copy or share your picks. Add a word or file as a seed to reproduce the same picks for the same game and line count. Files are processed in your browser. Seeds do not improve your odds; LottoRoll does not sell or check tickets.

records.name: Sourcefly.ai
records.tagline: Find the right candidates and target accounts with AI.
records.description: SourceFly (sourcefly.ai) is the sourcing intelligence platform by HR Analytica GmbH for executive search firms, headhunters, staffing agencies, and recruiting and HR teams. It searches more than 940+ million professional profiles and compares skills and requirements against ESCO, the European Commission's classification of skills and occupations. Talent pools, teamwork and export complete the platform. Guiding principle: AI suggests, people decide.

records.name: Privault-本地密码
records.tagline: 本地加密密码库 · 离线安全
records.description: Privault 是一款完全离线的本地密码管理器。你的密码只存储在本机沙盒中，经 AES-256-GCM 加密，不上传任何服务器——App 不申请网络权限，从物理层面杜绝数据外泄。 【核心功能】 • 密码库：账号、密码、网址、备注一站管理，支持自定义分类与归档 • 验证码（TOTP）：内置动态口令引擎，登录密码与 6 位验证码同屏展示，实时倒计时，扫码即绑 • 密码生成器：自定义长度与字符规则，一键生成高强度随机密码 • 安全审计：弱密码、重复密码、长期未改密自动体检，安全隐患一目了然 • 主密码保护：可选设置主密码，PBKDF2 21 万次迭代派生密钥，导出备份全字段加密 • iCloud 备份：应用级加密备份，最多保留最近 5 份，换机无忧 • 常用账号：邮箱、用户名预设，新建凭据一键填入 • 品牌图标：3400+ 品牌自动匹配，一眼识别常用网站 【隐私承诺】 零联网、零追踪、零收集。Face ID / 锁屏密码解锁仅为本地验证，生物信息不离开设备。 【多端体验】 完美适配 iPhone、iPad 与 Mac，支持深色模式与 11 种语言，界面随系统自动切换。…

records.name: Gizmos Studio
records.tagline: Cinematic 3D Videos, Made in Seconds
records.description: Meet Gizmos — a simple way to create cinematic 3D videos without animation experience. Choose from ready-made 3D templates, customize them with your own logos and media, and export a polished video. Whether you're launching a product, promoting a brand, or creating social media content, Gizmos helps bring your ideas to life. - No animation skills required. - Customizable 3D templates. - No subscriptions. Pay only when you export. Choose. Customize. Export.

records.name: Whatafile
records.tagline: Convert a file, and see what will survive before you run it.
records.description: Whatafile is an online file converter with more than 200 tools for documents, images, video and audio. Document conversions show the steps and a quality grade before you convert, and uploads are deleted 24 hours after each conversion. Most image, video and audio tools run in your browser, so those files never leave your device. No account, no watermark. Free for 3 conversions a day; Pro and Business add unlimited conversions and 100 MB files.

records.name: Nebula Estimating
records.tagline: Minimize time spent quoting
records.description: Our mission is to offer the most accurate proposals as autonomously as technology allows while keeping the user in control. In practice, that looks like you uploading photos, site notes, or audio after a customer walk, and Nebula produces a completed estimate while you drive back to the office. Proposal building is currently a painful process and, as former construction estimators, we believe it doesn't have to be.

records.name: Panorhélie
records.tagline: Find out which distant lands can be seen from your viewpoint
records.description: Wondering which island, coastline or mountain range you can see from a viewpoint? Pick any place on Earth, a date and a time. Panorhélie analyses the terrain through 360°, up to 400 km away, with the Earth’s curvature, then adds the weather forecast and the Sun’s position. The map shows the lands you can hope to see, the uncertain ones and those the weather hides. Estimates, not confirmed sightings. Web app in English and French: 3 free calculations, then €0.99 once.

records.name: founder-pipeline
records.tagline: Kill a bad business idea before you build it
records.description: Free Claude Code plugin that runs a business idea through 25 gated steps. A separate AI critic attacks each step. Three gates can kill the idea: no hours to give, no measured demand, or too little profit per hour. A number without a source prints "not available". MIT.

records.name: Face Rate
records.tagline: On-device face rating across six published geometry signals
records.description: Face Rate is a free, on-device face rating tool. It reads six published geometry signals — symmetry, golden proportion, facial thirds, facial fifths, eye area and jawline — straight from one front photo in your browser. The weights behind the score are published, so every reading can be reproduced. Your photo is never uploaded: it is drawn to a canvas, EXIF is stripped, and only numbers are kept. Two one-time reports go further — a Face Report and a Dating Report.

records.name: Doclyra
records.tagline: Free Online PDF Tools, Document Scanner & More
records.description: Meet Doclyra, an online platform designed to make working with documents simple and accessible from anywhere. Merge, split, compress, convert, scan and edit PDF documents directly from your phone or laptop, without downloading an app. We're building Doclyra into an all-in-one productivity platform, with more tools for everyday business and personal tasks coming soon. Try Doclyra at https://doclyra.app and share your feedback. We'd love to hear from you!

records.name: Kaso
records.tagline: Operating software for restaurants,production & distribution
records.description: Kaso is an integrated business operating system connecting point-of-sale, kitchen operations, production batch tracking, inventory ledgers, and commercial distribution fleets powered by Kaso IQ AI assistant and Studio IQ.

records.name: BuzzerScore
records.tagline: Keep a basketball score from the stands and share it live
records.description: Score your team's basketball matches period by period from the stands, keep a season record for every team you follow, and send family a live scoreboard link they can watch in any browser, with no app or account. Free with no ads; a Season Pass adds more for coaches and clubs.

records.name: IFAK Builder
records.tagline: Build a sourced first aid kit checklist for how you carry
records.description: IFAK Builder is a free, open-source web app that turns "what should be in my first aid kit?" into a checklist. Pick your scenario (everyday carry, hiking, hunting, range, vehicle, workplace or tactical), budget and pack size, and get a list ordered by the MARCH trauma sequence. Every item has a one-line reason and a link to a public guideline or study. Export to text or Markdown, share as a link, switch English/Chinese. No sign-up, no tracking, works offline. Education only, get trained too.

records.name: Google Play $2,200 Gift Card Sweepstakes
records.tagline: Google Play $2,200 Gift Card Sweepstakes – How to Enter

records.description: Prevedo projects every Premier League player six gameweeks ahead from bookmaker odds and FPL data, then plans your transfers, captain and chips. Use it on prevedo.app or plug it into the AI you already use: ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Cursor. You still decide.

records.name: Never Lose Text
records.tagline: Automatically saves what you type and lets you restore.
records.description: Automatically saves what you type and lets you quickly restore lost text with local-only storage. Never Lose Text helps you recover text you typed into websites, even if a tab crashes, a page refreshes, or a session expires. It quietly saves your input while you type, and lets you restore it right back into the field when you need it.

records.name: Vizaura Manage
records.tagline: Canadian Contractor Software, No Per-User Fees

records.description: Buy men trackpants online at Dazzle with comfortable fits for workouts, running & casual wear. Explore quality sportswear at great prices. Shop Now!

records.description: Write, run and learn Python right in your browser. Everything is free: no sign-up, nothing to install.

records.name: SysInfo DWG Converter Tool

records.description: Sysinfo DWG Converter is the most reliable AutoCAD DWG File Converter utility that helps to convert AutoCAD DWG, DXF, and DWF to PDF documents and (JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP) file formats.

records.name: ConvertMyFilePro
records.tagline: Convert images, PDFs, audio and video in your browser
records.description: Convert images, PDFs, documents, audio, video and subtitles directly in your browser. Extract text with OCR, compress videos and convert files without installing additional software. Start with free tools, or upgrade to PRO for larger file batches and unlimited daily OCR usage. Simple, private and built for everyday productivity.

records.name: Pendar Agentic Notebook App
records.tagline: Think deeply. Delegate wisely.
records.description: Keep your judgment sharp while working with AI. Pendar helps you think before you delegate, compare your expectations with an agent’s results, and learn from the difference through rehearsal, journaling, and exercises.

records.name: here
records.tagline: cli package manager mux. with flatpak, appimages, github
