records.name: LabourKhata: Wage & Attendance
records.tagline: Every Worker. Every Payment. One Khata.
records.description: LabourKhata: Wage & Attendance is a simple labour attendance app and daily wage calculator for contractors, builders, mistris, site supervisors and small business owners. Add your workers with photo, mark attendance in one tap, calculate wages automatically, record payments and advance, and see your full labour hisab in one place. Leave the paper register and notebook khata behind, and manage your workers with a fast, clear and easy app.

records.name: AddQart
records.tagline: E-Commerce & AI Website Builder
records.description: AddQart (also spelled Add Qart) is an all-in-one e-commerce platform, website builder, and free Cloud POS that lets businesses build, customize, and run an online or in-person store across 240+ countries without coding skills and with 0.0% platform transaction fees.

records.name: RaptorPoker
records.tagline: Provably fair Texas Hold'em in 1 click, no wallet or signup
records.description: Real-time multiplayer Texas Hold'em in your browser. Click once to play 6-max or 9-max tables with free auto-refill chips, and audit every deck byte-for-byte in /verify (SHA-256 + HMAC-SHA256). Optional wallet login unlocks rankings & Base NFT Figures.

records.name: vibecheck
records.tagline: Your Mac's mood, in one little ring.
records.description: Your Mac's mood, in one little ring. A native macOS menu bar system monitor.

records.name: StopBounceAI
records.tagline: Free Email Verifier and Finder
records.description: StopBounceAI verifies emails in real-time with 99.8% accuracy. Reduce bounce rates, protect your sender reputation, and reach more inboxes - trusted by 4,000+ teams.

records.name: AWDX CLI
records.tagline: AWDX (AWS DevOps X), next-generation CLI for AWS DevSecOps.
records.description: AWS DevOps X: Gen AI-powered AWS DevSecOps CLI tool with natural language interface. AWDX (AWS DevOps X) is a next-generation, human-friendly CLI tool for AWS DevSecOps. It helps you manage, automate, and secure your AWS environment with simple, interactive commands and smart suggestions.

records.name: Splitdibs
records.tagline: Turn your group chat into who does what
records.description: In every friend group, one person ends up organizing everything. Splitdibs splits the work: create a project, share one link in the group chat, and each friend taps "I'll take it". For birthdays, weekends away, family vacations, bachelorette parties, weddings. Free, on the web and iPhone.

records.name: YUGAMUGESH AI STUDIO
records.tagline: Multi-Language Transcriber, MP3 Cutter & YouTube SEO
records.description: Yugamugesh AI Studio: Instant multi-language audio to text transcriber (Tamil, English, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam), ElevenLabs-style AI Voice MP3 generator, Visual Waveform Audio Cutter, Audio Visualizer, and YouTube AI SEO & Thumbnail Studio.

records.name: LumiCloud
records.tagline: E2B-compatible sandboxes for AI agents, in Singapore
records.description: Sandboxes for AI agents on Firecracker microVMs in Singapore. LumiCloud serves the E2B API: set E2B_DOMAIN=lumicloud.dev and a key, and your E2B code runs unchanged. Pause and resume, snapshots, browser and desktop templates, a remote MCP server. Billed per second.

records.name: Rejist
records.tagline: Know who's on site, from check-in to roll-call
records.description: Replace paper visitor books with digital check-in and a live on-site roster. Rejist notifies hosts, issues digital badges and keeps access-controlled visit records so reception and security teams can handle arrivals and roll-calls. A free plan is available alongside paid plans.

records.name: Qawli
records.tagline: Bot-free AI meeting & voice notes across 99+ languages
records.description: Turn meetings and voice notes into speaker-labelled transcripts, aligned translations and action items across 99+ languages. Switch languages mid-sentence, recognise returning speakers with VoiceID, and search past meetings from Claude or Cursor.

records.name: EndureQR
records.tagline: Free QR codes, plus dynamic ones that survive cancelling
records.description: Most QR services switch your codes off when a trial or plan ends. EndureQR makes codes that last: free static QR codes in 17 types with your logo, no sign-up or watermark, plus dynamic codes you can edit after printing that keep working if you cancel.

records.name: Folium
records.tagline: Free resume builder in 23 languages, no sign-up to download
records.description: Write your resume in the browser and download it as PDF or Word: no account, no watermark. 30 templates and a PDF with real text that ATS software can read. New: import an old CV, change it by asking Ask Folium, translate it, and tailor it to a job posting.

records.name: Geora by A-Case
records.tagline: Ultra-slim carbon fiber iPhone case with MagSafe
records.description: Keep your iPhone 18 Pro Max slim, comfortable to hold, and distinctly yours. Geora combines lightweight carbon fiber with a mosaic-inspired pattern, MagSafe compatibility, and a raised camera ring that helps protect lenses from surface scratches. Available in red and black. UAE delivery only.

records.name: Sensoreal Brand Protocol
records.tagline: Brand guidelines, built in minutes!
records.description: The professional brand guidelines builder for brand managers, designers and creative studios. Fill in up to 14 structured sections and get a publication-ready brand book you can share with a link.

records.name: Touchbase
records.tagline: Meet someone new in your field every week
records.description: One matched call a week with someone else in your field. No cold messages, just the network you'll need later.

records.name: Peekchess
records.tagline: Chess puzzles that train calculation
records.description: Peekchess is a chess puzzle app that trains calculation. The board stays still, so you work out the whole line in your head before you play it.

records.name: Greetfolk
records.tagline: One inbox and an AI receptionist for your business
records.description: Greetfolk is a front desk for your business. Website chat, email and Messenger land in one shared inbox. An AI receptionist answers the usual questions day and night and books the visit. Customers book online from your real schedule. Free for as long as you like: your website, online booking and 100 AI answers a month.

records.name: JamLoom
records.tagline: Create backing tracks from your chord charts
records.description: JamLoom is a backing track creator for Windows and Linux. Turn chord charts into bass, drums and guitar accompaniment, loop sections for practice, adjust the mix, and export MIDI or WAV. Get the free Community Edition from the official download page.

records.name: Mobile Gaming Ping
records.tagline: Ping and Wi-Fi tools for mobile gamers
records.description: Mobile Gaming Ping helps Android gamers check ping, Wi-Fi signal and connection conditions. It includes a home-screen control widget and game-region guidance. Results vary by game, device, server, region and connection.

records.name: Polylane Swarms
records.tagline: A team of AI agents on your roughest production incidents
records.description: Put a swarm of agents on your massive production incidents. Agents investigate possible causes in parallel, share evidence and check each other's findings. You get one answer with the root cause, the evidence and a proposed fix.

records.name: Dreamwork
records.tagline: The job search agent that only applies where you fit
records.description: Dreamwork reads your resume and matches you against millions of live roles. Tap Apply and it writes a fully editable resume and cover letter for that role, then fills out the employer's application directly. Add writing samples to keep your voice. You can turn on autopilot and have it apply overnight, or you can edit each submission with granular detail. The choice is yours. Matching and tailored applications are free. No ads, and no employer can pay to rank higher.

records.name: freddy
records.tagline: Private health data server: talk to your health with any AI
records.description: freddy is your health data server. Connect your wearables, rings, glucose monitors, training apps, Apple Health and Health Connect once, and add your lab results. freddy keeps every value as the source sends it. Use it with any AI, export it, or build on it.

records.name: Othor AI
records.tagline: Your Head of Intelligence. Know what your numbers are hiding
records.description: Othor AI is a new species of business intelligence, built on the tradecraft of intelligence agencies and a century of signal analysis. Automated statistical intelligence for business leaders: more signal, faster decisions, with the smallest possible AI bill and the least human effort. AI drafts the words; code computes every number, and any night can be replayed byte for byte. Open source (Apache-2.0); hosted or on your servers.

records.name: ModernTechLap
records.tagline: Get recommended by AI assistants, not just Google
records.description: When buyers ask ChatGPT or Gemini "which tool should I pick?", do they hear your name? ModernTechLap asks AI assistants the questions your buyers ask, shows who gets recommended and which sources they cite, explains why competitors win, and gives you ranked actions to fix it. Then it measures what changed. Free account: 25 buyer questions, results in about 10 minutes, no card needed.

records.name: Cully
records.tagline: The harness runtime for software work.
records.description: Cully is the open-source harness around Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and other coding agents. Solo mode: a live advisor that flags loops, unchecked edits, and full context; private memory (Postgres + self-hosted Mem0); replay and handoff; and a scout that finds tools, skills, and hooks for your task, which you approve. Team mode: tasks owned by the team, with claims, checkpoints anyone can resume in any agent, evidence-backed review, and shared lessons. Local-first, Apache-2.0.

records.name: Polyglobe
records.tagline: Hear a language, then pin where it's spoken
records.description: Listen to a short clip, then drop a pin where you think the language is spoken. The closer your pin, the more points you get. Play the Daily (five clips, the same for everyone), Classic, Streak, Rapid, or Arena live with friends. Turn on Accents to tell Spanish from Spain and Argentina apart. After each round, read what the clip said with a translation and a fun fact. More than 100 languages and dialects. Free with no ads, on iPhone, Android and the web.

records.name: calculingo
records.tagline: a native macOS calculator you type at in plain words
records.description: Calculingo is a natural language-based notepad-style calculator for MacOS. It calculates your queries at every stroke. Dates in any format and the days between them, time in cities, currency at today's rate, units, distances, primes and statistics. In addition to the main MacOS app, there's an Alfred workflow that comes with it if you buy a license. The workflow can be found at: https://github.com/andreisuslov/calculingo-app.

records.name: Coldhold
records.tagline: Free watch-only cold wallet tracker with 14 networks.
records.description: Coldhold shows everything you hold, on hardware wallets and hot wallets alike, in one total. Paste public addresses or a Bitcoin xpub from Ledger, Trezor, Tangem, MetaMask, Phantom or any other wallet and see balances on 14 networks, from Bitcoin and Ethereum to Solana, Tron, TON and XRP, with a year of history and a feed of transfers. No account, no email, no keys: the wallet list stays on your device. Free, runs in the browser and installs as a web app.

records.name: Lumora Writes
records.tagline: Type your text into Google Docs like a real person
records.description: Lumora Writes is a Chrome extension that types your text into Google Docs, Slides, Sheets, Forms and Canva with natural pacing instead of pasting it all at once. Pick a speed, see a realistic time estimate, and keep it running in the background. Built first as an assistive tool for people who find typing hard or tiring. Includes Human Polish to rewrite drafts in the tone and grade level you choose.

records.name: Tanem
records.tagline: A digital advent calendar where every door is from you
records.description: Tanem lets you make a digital advent calendar for someone you love. Fill 24 (or 30) doors with photos, notes, coupons, invites, treasure-hunt clues, questions and songs, pick one of six themes, and choose when the doors open. Send one link: they open it in the browser, no app or account needed. One door unlocks per day and locked doors never leave the server, so no peeking. Optional secret question. One-time purchase per calendar, no subscription.

records.name: StrategyQuant
records.tagline: Create your own algo-strategies using AI agents
records.description: Have a trading idea—or want Q to suggest one? Q, the AI agent in StrategyQuant X, helps you turn ideas into strategies, backtest them and explore the results. No coding needed. This update also adds prop trading analysis, a marketplace for strategies and extensions, COT data to explore how large traders are positioned, and NinjaTrader 8 support. Spend less time setting things up and more time testing your ideas.

records.name: ExtraBar
records.tagline: Build a custom menu bar for your Mac
records.description: Your Mac menu bar fills up with icons you never click, while the things you do every day stay buried in menus. ExtraBar lets you build a menu bar around the apps you actually use.

records.name: Scrisly
records.tagline: Cold emails written from a fact on each lead's own website
records.description: Scrisly is cold email software for small B2B teams. It reads your website to learn what you sell, finds leads from a brief in plain words and verifies every address. Then it writes one email per person, in their language, from a fact on their own website. Every draft gets a spam score and a claim check. You approve, and it sends from your own mailbox at a warm-up pace. No tracking pixels, no seats, no monthly plan: free trial credits that never expire, then prepaid credits from €10.

records.name: Listos.app
records.tagline: Free browser productivity tools, no account needed
records.description: Listos.app is a free suite of everyday productivity tools that run 100% locally in your browser—no sign-up, no downloads, and no file uploads. Includes a work hours calculator, HEIC/PNG/WEBP/AVIF image converter, Pomodoro timer, date calculator, color palette generator, local clipboard, unit converter, statistics calculator, and ALT codes finder.

records.name: Tech Timmy's Data Actors
records.tagline: Pay-per-result data tools: leads, transcripts, filings
records.description: Small Apify actors that turn public data into rows you can use: Google Maps businesses with no website (for web designers), YouTube transcripts, jobs from company career pages, recently funded startups from SEC Form D, SAM.gov bids and more. You run one and pay per result, no subscription. Every row says what it is, an empty input runs a working example, and AI agents can call them through Apify's MCP server. The code is on GitHub.

records.name: Estuda Simples
records.tagline: Gerador de capa, sumário e referências ABNT grátis
records.description: Estuda Simples ajuda estudantes a preparar trabalhos acadêmicos no formato ABNT sem complicação. Gere gratuitamente capa, folha de rosto, sumário e referências, sem cadastro e diretamente no navegador. Uma ferramenta prática para organizar a apresentação do seu trabalho e economizar tempo na formatação.

records.name: Koroty
records.tagline: Elegant wedding e-invites with one-tap RSVP for every guest
records.description: Koroty lets couples design an elegant wedding or engagement invitation in minutes and send it to every guest by name on WhatsApp. Choose from 24 designs with cinematic openings (wax-sealed envelopes, palace doors, scratch-to-reveal gold), add the venue map, countdown, gallery, dress code and gift details, then track RSVPs and wishes from one dashboard, with QR tickets for the door. Available in English and Arabic. Preview free, pay once to publish.

records.name: Restobesto
records.tagline: Restaurant posts from your own dish photo, without AI slop
records.description: Restobesto makes Instagram posts, stories and posters for restaurants. Upload your own dish photo and restyle the light and setting while keeping your real plate, or make a picture straight from a menu line, with nothing invented off the menu. Snap your menu to import dishes, save your own looks, and get captions in your own style for free. You approve every picture. 3 posts free, then a month of posts for €9, prepaid, no subscription.

records.name: OddForge SiteAudit PRO
records.tagline: Audit websites for SEO and quality issues
records.description: SiteAudit PRO helps web designers, freelancers and small agencies find common website problems. Scan up to 75 accessible HTML pages for issues such as missing metadata, broken internal links, heading problems and missing image alt text. Export practical audit reports in HTML, CSV or JSON. Runs locally with Python 3; requires internet access to scan sites. £39 one-time purchase, no subscription.

records.name: Fighter Bootcamp
records.tagline: SEO and AI Search Courses
records.description: Fighter Bootcamp is a multi-track online bootcamp from Search Agency that teaches topic ownership, AI search (GEO), copywriting, AI for marketing work, digital PR, AI visibility measurement, content for AI answers, and SEO and security for AI-built sites through interactive courses, quizzes, exams, and verifiable certificates.

records.name: Glidecast
records.tagline: The ultimate screen recorder: auto editing, any platform
records.description: Privacy first: your screen never leaves your computer. Record a tab, a window or your screen in Chrome on Windows, Mac or Linux. Glidecast edits as you record: auto zoom on clicks, smooth cursor, auto captions, and emails, amounts and passwords blurred automatically. Add intro and outro cards, your camera with a blurred or replaced background, noise reduction, cuts, speed changes and a background. Free in 1080p, no watermark, no account. Pro: 4K and your logo.

records.name: CleanPDF Unlock PDF
records.tagline: Remove the password from your own PDFs. Nothing uploaded.
records.description: Tired of typing a password every time you open your own PDF? Enter it once and save an unlocked copy. Print, edit and copy restrictions on your files are removed too. Works with 40-bit and 128-bit RC4 and 128-bit and 256-bit AES. It never cracks or guesses passwords. Everything runs in your browser, so your file and password are never uploaded. Free, no sign-up.

records.name: Contour
records.tagline: Segment Anything (SAM 3) on your Mac, fully on-device
records.description: Contour is a native Mac workstation built on Meta's Segment Anything (SAM 3 and 3.1) with Florence 2 for captions and detection, running entirely on-device with MLX. Drop in a folder, write a prompt or draw a box, tune thresholds instantly, and export COCO, YOLO, masks or cutouts. It also tracks up to 16 objects through video. No cloud, no API key. Free for personal single-image use, Pro is $19.99 once for batch, video, dataset exports and commercial use.

records.name: AI API Cost Calculator
records.tagline: Compare live API costs across every major AI model
records.description: A free calculator to work out and compare what any AI model actually costs before you build. Paste a prompt to estimate tokens, or enter the numbers yourself, then compare live per-request and monthly pricing for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, xAI Grok, DeepSeek and every other major model, side by side. Prices are pulled live so the comparison stays current. No sign-up, no account. Built by Saraswati Stitch, an AI automation agency.

records.name: itogai
records.tagline: More meetings from the relationships you already have
records.description: itogai is the relationship intelligence platform for B2B founders, sales teams and partner programs. It scores your relationships, shows who can make the warm intro you need, and drafts the ask with Akai™. You review every message and send it yourself.

records.name: shortlistOS
records.tagline: A personal CRM for your job search
records.description: shortlistOS is a personal CRM for tracking job applications and everything that follows: recruiter conversations, interviews, notes, files, and follow-ups. It starts with a ready-made Kanban pipeline. The hosted workspace is free; optional Powerpack features help you capture job postings, process forwarded emails, and remember follow-ups. Open-source and self-hostable.

records.name: CupMeasure
records.tagline: Convert grams, cups and spoons for everyday recipes
records.description: CupMeasure is a free kitchen measurement converter for home cooks and bakers. Convert grams, cups, tablespoons, mL and ounces; choose flour, sugar or butter for weight-to-volume estimates. Compare US and metric cups, see visual results, and use reference charts and measuring guides. No account needed.

records.name: Amigo Treks & Expedition
records.tagline: Private treks & tours in Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan
records.description: Amigo Treks & Expedition is a Kathmandu-based team that plans private treks, cultural tours, helicopter journeys and luxury trips across Nepal, Tibet and Bhutan. Compare routes and prices, shape a custom itinerary with the Trip Designer, and let the team handle permits, hotels, transport, guides and on-ground support. Rated 4.9/5 from 554 traveller reviews.

records.name: Dx
records.tagline: Pure-Rust AI TUI with LSP editor, media player & 47 ACPs
records.description: Dx is a pure-Rust AI coding TUI that replaces the usual trade-off between tool richness and token efficiency. Edit code with a built-in LSP editor, preview images and play videos inside the file browser, review diffs with free CodeRabbit-grade analysis and AI intent summaries, orchestrate agentic git workflows with GitHarness, connect across 47 ACPs and 350+ AI providers, and cut session tokens by 15–90% using a Rust-native RLM that runs 20+ tools at near-Pi token overhead.

records.name: DilFit
records.tagline: Fitness challenges you prove on video, with live stats
records.description: DilFit is a fitness challenge app for iPhone and Apple Watch where you prove it on video. Join 100 challenges or create your own with friends, film your attempt with live stats burned in (reps, sets, load, timer, pace) and let other athletes watch and vote. Underneath is a full workout tracker: last session's numbers beside every set, PR detection, programs and 1,500 exercises. Use your watch as a camera remote and post clips to TikTok, Reels or Shorts. Free, optional Pro.

records.name: DeskWand
records.tagline: Your phone as a touchpad for your PC, even at sign-in
records.description: DeskWand turns your Android phone into a touchpad and keyboard for a Windows PC on your home network – and it already works at the sign-in screen, so you can sign in to the PC under your TV from the sofa. Gestures, your phone's own keyboard, about 40 shortcuts, Wake-on-LAN and a live preview of the PC screen. Native on x64 and Arm64. No account, no ads, no analytics. One PC is free; Pro is a one-time purchase.

records.name: Oran
records.tagline: See where your Shopify store leaks revenue
records.description: Oran compares your funnel with Littledata benchmarks from 424 Shopify stores, puts a monthly dollar figure on each leak, ranks the fixes, and tests whether a fix worked. Free checkout leak calculator. 14-day trial, no credit card.

records.name: Twinhoods
records.tagline: Translate any city into the one you know
records.description: Pick a city you know and one you're curious about. Twinhoods redraws the second with names from the first: for a Londoner, Berlin's Neukölln is Peckham. 190+ cities, free, no account. Rate each match, vote your city in, or print your pair as a poster.

records.name: FlowKit Tracker: Warranty
records.tagline: Track receipts, warranties & subscriptions in a local vault.
records.description: Turn your receipts, invoices, devices, and recurring services into organized, searchable cards. FlowKit Tracker helps you manage device warranties, return windows, maintenance schedules, subscriptions, and memberships inside an encrypted local vault on your Android device. Save purchase dates, optional delivery dates, warranty durations (standard months or custom 1–120 months / 1–3650 days), and 14- or 30-day return windows.

records.name: Takasla
records.tagline: Swap unused items for things you actually need
records.description: Takasla is a secondhand swapping app built in Türkiye. List items you no longer use, explore listings, send exchange offers, and chat with other members when an offer is accepted. Give belongings a second life without buying everything new. Available on iOS; Android is currently in testing.

records.name: Slip Away
records.tagline: Your perfect excuse is just one phone call away.
records.description: Slip Away is a free, open-source Android app that lets you escape awkward social situations with realistic incoming calls. Schedule calls, customize callers, and use Android's native calling interface. No ads, no tracking, and no account required.

records.name: pinguHQ
records.tagline: uptime monitoring, incidents and status pages
records.description: Uptime monitoring with HTTP, ping, port, DNS, SSL, keyword and cron heartbeat checks. Incidents open and resolve themselves, alerts go to email, Slack, webhook or Telegram, and status pages update from the checks rather than by hand.

records.name: Gamerbase
records.tagline: A game tracking database with benchmarks and can i run it
records.description: GamerBase (gamerbase.co) is an all-in-one PC game database and hardware utility platform built to help PC gamers check game compatibility, compare real-world frame rates, and plan smart hardware upgrades. Instead of relying on generic minimum spec sheets, GamerBase lets you auto-detect your GPU, CPU, RAM, and target resolution right in your browser to see personalized performance estimates across games.

records.name: BidLift
records.tagline: Turn 1-price quotes into +28% bigger deals in 60 seconds
records.description: Stop losing margin to flat PDF estimates. BidLift turns single-price quotes into interactive Good / Better / Best proposals with toggleable upsells, SHA-256 verified e-signatures, and instant Stripe/Venmo/Zelle deposit links. • 6 industry templates + live Revenue-Lift Coach • E-sign canvas, ESIGN audit trail & print PDF receipt • 100% browser-private — entire quote lives in the #q= URL hash (zero login, zero server PII)

records.name: GachaSnap
records.tagline: Rediscover your photos, one capsule at a time
records.description: Turn your photo library into a capsule machine. Spin the knob and open a capsule to rediscover a photo you already took. Reveal a Daily Surprise, choose which memories to revisit, and add favorite photos to your Home Screen. When you find a photo you no longer want, set it aside for review before confirming deletion.

records.name: Pawkip
records.tagline: A touchscreen game made for curious cats
records.description: Turn your iPhone or iPad into a play space for your cat. Choose fish, mice or butterflies to chase, switch backgrounds, adjust target size and sounds, or create a target from a photo. See catches and play time, and optionally record highlights. Place your device on a stable surface and let your cat play at their own pace.

records.name: SetGo
records.tagline: Workouts built for your time, gear and body in seconds
records.description: SetGo builds a workout around how long you have, the gear you own and how fit you are, in seconds. Follow it with timers and a voice coach, or build a multi-day plan that progresses. Unlimited free workouts, and you can try one without signing up.

records.name: ToleHub
records.tagline: Free tools for invoices, calculations and data conversion
records.description: ToleHub brings practical online tools into one free, easy-to-use place. Create PDF invoices, calculate ROI, markup and profit margins, convert JSON to CSV or XML to JSON, and generate UUID v4/v7 identifiers. Built for freelancers, small businesses and developers, with no sign-up required. Many tools run directly in your browser.

records.name: QuickInvoice
records.tagline: Invoices for Brazilian freelancers and MEIs
records.description: QuickInvoice helps Brazilian freelancers and microentrepreneurs (MEIs) create commercial invoices in reais, save client details with CPF or CNPJ, and track what's pending or paid. Create an itemized invoice and download the PDF directly in your browser, free and without signing up. The interface is in Brazilian Portuguese.

records.name: Kawhe
records.tagline: Digital loyalty for cafés, saved to Apple & Google Wallet
records.description: Kawhe helps independent cafés replace paper stamp cards with branded digital loyalty cards. Customers join by QR code and use their card in a browser, Apple Wallet or Google Wallet—no customer app needed. Staff use the free iPhone or Android Merchant app to add stamps and redeem rewards. Start free, with an optional Pro plan as you grow.

records.name: Moti Hoppe Maker
records.tagline: Squish your pictures into bouncy, mochi-style animations
records.description: Turn your pictures into squishy, mochi-style creations. Pull, pinch, stretch, and squish with elastic spring-back effects, or keep your edits. Save PNG/JPG images or record GIF/WebM animations. Free, with no sign-up; image processing stays on your device. Works on desktop and mobile, in 8 languages.

records.name: Madowan
records.tagline: A pixel dog that cheers when your AI agent finishes
records.description: A pixel dog that lives on your desktop. It follows your mouse, stretches like mochi, reminds you to walk and drink water, and jumps for joy when Claude Code or Codex finishes. Nine breeds, no accounts, no analytics or telemetry. One-time purchase for macOS and Windows.

records.name: songrestyle.com
records.tagline: Upload a song. Share your idea. Hear a new version.
records.description: What would your acoustic demo sound like as synth-pop or jazz? Upload an MP3 or WAV, describe the arrangement you have in mind, and keep or edit the lyrics. Try a short preview before generating the full song, or listen to original and restyled clips side by side in the template library.

records.name: SKAEL
records.tagline: From one prompt to a full-stack app, live on your domain
records.description: SKAEL builds real software from plain language: SaaS dashboards, internal tools, multiplayer games, booking systems, online stores. The AI writes the frontend and backend, sets up the database and user logins, tests everything in a live preview, and publishes to your own domain. Import existing code from Git or ZIP, export everything anytime. 5,000 free AI credits on sign-up.

records.name: TransToText
records.tagline: Transcribe, translate and edit audio & video in your browser
records.description: Turn recordings, videos and YouTube links into editable transcripts and timed subtitles. Review text alongside playback, identify speakers, translate your transcript and export SRT, VTT, TXT and document formats. Try the public 30-second example before uploading. Start free without an account or credit card.

records.name: RingOwl Checkin
records.tagline: Gratitude Journal That Calls You: A Daily Check-in Call
records.description: A gratitude journal you don't have to remember to open. RingOwl Check-in calls you at the time you pick, asks about the good parts of your day, then emails you your journal entry. Try a call in your browser. 7 days free, no card needed.

records.name: Pluggyback
records.tagline: Show other makers' products on your site, get yours shown
records.description: Pluggyback is a free swap network for indie software. Paste two lines of HTML and your site shows a small card for another member's product, and yours is shown on other members' sites. A card seen on your site earns 1 credit, yours seen elsewhere costs 2, you start with 100 and clicks are free. The card sets no cookies, a person checks every product, and you pick which categories appear. Launch free on any day you pick: for 7 days, launches share 20% of all card views. The network is brand new.

records.name: TaskKind: To-Do & Reminders
records.tagline: Location reminders and one-tap actions for Android
records.description: TaskKind is an Android to-do list and reminder app. Get reminded to clock in when you arrive at work or grab your keys when you leave home. Open a bill payment page or your running app straight from a notification. Type reminders in everyday language, plan recurring tasks in a weekly calendar, and break bigger jobs into checklists.

records.name: LIFEQUEST
records.tagline: Turn workouts, meals and habits into an RPG adventure
records.description: LIFEQUEST turns your real-life routine into an RPG. Log workouts, meals and daily habits to earn Forge XP, raise your stats, rank up with Aether Points and take on quests and bosses across the world of Aetheria. Aether Vision AI helps track your fitness, so progress in real life becomes progress in the game. Built for anyone who finds the gym or healthy eating boring and wants a reason to stay consistent.

records.name: Asaan Optics
records.tagline: Optical shop software for Windows, Android, iPhone & iPad
records.description: Asaan Optics runs an optical shop: the prescription (SPH, CYL, AXIS, ADD, PD) is saved with every order, frame and lens stock is tracked with barcodes, and the counter handles POS billing, cash shifts, repairs and receipts on thermal or A4 printers. The Windows desktop keeps billing offline; the Android, iPhone and iPad apps use the same shop account. 9 languages including Urdu and Arabic, and ZATCA Phase 2 e-invoicing for Saudi shops on the desktop. Desktop free for 30 days.

records.name: Pad Notes AI: Note Taking
records.tagline: Apple Pencil notes, PDF annotation, study tape & offline AI
records.description: Handwrite, type, annotate PDFs and study in one private notebook on iPad, iPhone and Mac. Pad Notes AI pairs natural Apple Pencil inks (pen, fountain, watercolor, reed, hold-to-shape) with interactive Memorization Tape—cover formulas or definitions, recall them, and tap to peel back—plus live audio recording with offline transcription, on-device page translation, 19 paper templates, and an AI assistant that creates summaries, explanations, quizzes and flashcards from your notes.

records.name: UKBankConnect.co.uk
records.tagline: Connect your UK bank accounts to your AI. Read only.
records.description: Connect your UK bank accounts once, then let your AI and your software read them. Ask Claude or ChatGPT where your money went. Give your accountant or your CRM read only access, and take it back at any time. It is read only: it cannot initiate payments or move money. You approve access on your own bank's screen through TrueLayer. £2.50 a month for each connected bank account. First 30 days free.

records.name: Tea Tree Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled tea tree essential oil, no fillers
records.description: Rootsar Tea Tree Essential Oil is steam-distilled from the leaves of the Australian Melaleuca alternifolia tree. It has a sharp, herbal scent, with no fillers or artificial fragrance. Use it in your skin care, hair care and home routines.

records.name: Synexa - Notes
records.tagline: Just Write. Stay Organised.
records.description: Filing is a decision you're forced to make before you're allowed to think. Synexa is a handwriting app for iPad and Apple Pencil that replaces folders with relationships. You write first. Afterwards, you say what the note relates to - and it appears on every board it belongs to, simultaneously. It was never copied and never moved. There is exactly one note. A meeting note is about the client, and the pricing review, and something a colleague said. Three homes, one piece of paper.

records.name: Scena
records.tagline: Your camera roll, cut into reels ready to post
records.description: Scena is for people who want to post a good-looking reel without spending hours in an editor. Choose your photos and a look, or just pick an album, and Scena keeps the best shots and makes the reel. Sizzle goes through your camera roll and suggests trips and weekends that would make a good reel. To change something, type what you want and Director makes the edit. Scena is available on iOS and Android and is free to try.

records.name: Mobile Agent Testers
records.tagline: Free open-source AI agents that beta-test your app on phones
records.description: No test scripts. Each tester is an AI agent with its own Android emulator or iOS Simulator on GitHub Actions, playing a persona: iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size, Pixel 7 at 200%, iPad in German, Arabic right to left. It uses your app like a new user and writes a bug report with screenshots, then one summary groups the duplicates. Open source. Flutter, React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Swift, KMP, Capacitor,NET MAUI, or a prebuilt APK.

records.name: Finansealy
records.tagline: Expense tracker that logs payments from your notifications
records.description: Finansealy logs your spending with almost no typing. Bank and e-wallet notifications, receipt photos, screenshots and your voice become records, and the same payment is never counted twice. Budgets run from payday to payday, and Sealy, a psychic seal, answers questions about your money.

records.name: Movie Scene
records.tagline: Swipe, Track & Discover Movies
records.description: Movie Scene helps you answer “What should we watch tonight?” Pick your streaming services, swipe through movies and shows, and save your yeses and maybes to a private shortlist. When the credits roll, log what you watched, rate it, or leave a note on the exact scene you’re still thinking about.

records.name: PlankUI
records.tagline: React components for Tailwind v4, on Radix or Base UI
records.description: PlankUI is a free, MIT-licensed set of 91 React components for Tailwind CSS v4. Pick Radix UI or Base UI, then copy the source into your project with one CLI command (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun or deno). One set of CSS variables drives six themes, five styles and dark mode. It ships 438 matching icons and an MCP server so Cursor, Claude Code and other agents install the real components instead of guessing.

records.name: Lemongrass Essential Oil
records.tagline: Steam-distilled lemongrass oil, bright zesty citrus scent
records.description: Rootsar Lemongrass Essential Oil is steam-distilled from the tall, fragrant blades of the Cymbopogon plant. It has a bright, zesty citrus scent with a soft green edge. 100% natural and 100% vegan. Use it in a kitchen diffuser, an all-purpose surface spray or your mop water.

records.name: EcomUp
records.tagline: AI that runs your online shop's chats, orders and posts
records.description: EcomUp is the AI that runs your online shop. It replies to Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp chats, takes orders, books couriers, makes product photos and reels, plans and publishes posts with Agent Mode, and runs automations and WhatsApp campaigns. AI confirmation calls coming soon. Pricing: Growth $27/mo, Scale $97/mo, Elite $147/mo, WhatsApp API Special $19/mo. Save with yearly billing or pay once for lifetime access. 14-day free trial.

records.name: Agent City
records.tagline: Your AI coding agents as gangs in a 3D Miami Beach
records.description: Agent City turns the AI coding sessions you already run into a 3D open-world Miami Beach built from OpenStreetMap. Each Claude Code or omp session is a gang; subagents walk to places that match their tool and show their file and status, so stuck or waiting agents stand out. omp adds live cost and an opt-in phone to steer. Free, MIT, runs on 127.0.0.1 with no keys or telemetry: npx agent-city-ai. Play the demo in your browser: https://lulu-the-narwhal.github.io/agent-city/

records.name: JobReportKit: Photo Reports
records.tagline: Photo Report App for Contractors
records.description: Document before-and-after work photos, add notes and annotations, and create clear reports your customers can keep. Start with 3 free projects every month. No account required.

records.name: Stickman Hook
records.tagline: One-button swinging game with 100+ levels. No download.
records.description: Stickman Hook is a free swinging game you play in the browser - no download, no install, no sign-up. Hold the mouse button, space bar, or your finger to grab the next hook; release to fly. Land on the platform at the end of the level instead of dropping into the gap. There are over 100 levels, and finishing them unlocks new characters. Runs last seconds, there is no lives counter and no timer, so a bad swing costs you a second - which is why one more try turns into twenty.

records.name: EazyReader
records.tagline: Markdown, made readable. Free for Mac and PC
records.description: EazyReader turns the Markdown your AI tools and repos produce into a calm, clean read. Open anymd file in a clear reading view, with real headings and no syntax in the way, and organize them into Reading Rooms. Edit and highlight in place. Documents stay on your computer and never go to the cloud. Works inside Claude and Cursor via the MCP connector at https://eazyreader.ai/mcp (no sign-in). Free for Mac and PC. EazyReader Teams is coming soon. EazyReader Enterprise: Contact us on the site.

records.name: Dingdo
records.tagline: AI Receptionist for Solo Service Professionals
records.description: Dingdo is an AI receptionist for independent service professionals. Keep your existing number with supported call forwarding and answer calls yourself when you're available. When you're busy, Dingdo answers common questions, captures callback and appointment requests, and saves a call summary for you to review.

records.name: ➤QRForge⌘
records.tagline: Free QR codes with your own logo, no sign-up, no watermark
records.description: Create a free QR code with your own logo in seconds. URL, WiFi, vCard, WhatsApp, Email and more. High-quality PNG and SVG export, no sign-up, no watermark, nothing uploaded. Static QR codes that never expire.

records.name: Gardens
records.tagline: The social browser
records.description: Gardens is a social browser for community-built apps. Discover apps through people you follow, open them without another signup, and use agents that can understand your context and work together. Build and improve apps through chat, monetize them however you choose, and keep your identity and private data in a layer you control. Gardens can also run AI locally, so sensitive context stays on your Mac. Currently available as an early beta for macOS.

records.name: HiHuman
records.tagline: Your child earns points for real-life tasks, you confirm
records.description: HiHuman turns chores, study and workouts into a points game for kids, run from Telegram. Parents set the tasks, the points each one is worth, the weekly target and the reward. The child marks what is done in their own app inside Telegram, and anything that needs checking comes to the parent. At 8 pm the parent gets a daily summary and confirms with one button. On Sunday the target decides the reward. The point is upbringing: agreements and habits, not screen-time policing.

records.name: Ink Studio
records.tagline: Digital Painting, Manga & Collaboration
records.description: Ink Studio is a free, open-source desktop studio for digital painting, manga and webtoon creation, cel animation, and real-time multiplayer drawing. Built with Tauri, Rust, and React, it pairs a WebGL brush engine with Clip Studio Paint (.clip/.sut) &psd support, manga frames & screentones, an interactive 3D IK pose mannequin, and LAN/online collaboration for up to 16 artists.

records.name: Who’s GEO?
records.tagline: See how often ChatGPT and Gemini recommend your business
records.description: Your customers ask ChatGPT and Gemini before they search. Who's GEO? asks both engines the questions they would ask about your business and counts two things: how often you are mentioned, and how often you are actually recommended. You also see who gets recommended instead, which sites the AI cites, and what to fix on your site, most urgent first. Download the fixes as Markdown and hand them to your own AI. Free preview, no sign-up, not even an email.

records.name: ThatDevGuy.in — Developer Portfolio
records.tagline: Portfolio of a full-stack & AI engineer who ships products
records.description: The personal portfolio of Subhadip Saha, a full-stack software engineer and AI engineer from Bangalore. Browse shipped projects like CodeNearby, Corvin, Anvil SDK and Cache Pot, a work history spanning ISRO and startups, a blog on AI agents, MCP and production engineering, plus a guestbook. Built with Next.js, it's fast, dark-mode first, and even ships a CLI: run npx subh to meet me in your terminal.

records.name: StratEdge Global
records.tagline: Build your team in India. Not an operation.
records.description: Hire, employ and engage your people in India on one platform instead of three vendors. HireEdge finds and vets candidates, our own Indian company employs them legally, and EmpleYor lets you manage them alongside your own team. Contract and payroll in 48 hours from complete documents. All-inclusive plans from $349 per employee/month with health insurance from day one. Sign with a US company, pay in USD, month-to-month with no lock-in.

records.name: Archive Press
records.tagline: Send files up to 2 GB free, with a password, no signup
records.description: Send large files without making an account. Drop files up to 2 GB, add an optional password, and your recipient gets a download link by email. Links expire after 7 days, and you're notified when the files are downloaded. No ads.

records.name: Deal Chef: Meal plans & Deals
records.tagline: AI meal plans from grocery deals and your pantry.
records.description: Turn grocery deals and pantry staples into budget-friendly meals with AI. Auto-sync weekly sales from supported major grocery stores or scan local flyers, plan meals across stores, personalize recipes to your dietary preferences, and rescue leftovers. See estimated costs per serving. Use the free pantry, shopping list and shared shopping lists. Upgrade for AI meal planning. Available on iOS and Android.

records.name: ShopLens™
records.tagline: AI Shopping Copilot for UAE, Saudi & Pakistan
records.description: ShopLens is an AI shopping copilot for the UAE, Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. Describe what you need in plain language — no exact model numbers or filter trees — and ShopLens compares verified retailer prices and specs across regional stores in one clear shortlist. Every recommendation names a winner and explains the trade-offs, then links you to the retailer's own page to confirm and buy. Search on the web or over WhatsApp. Free to use.

records.name: UGCGen
records.tagline: Direct an AI agent to create UGC video ads
records.description: Turn a product brief or image into UGC-style video ads. Draft and edit hooks, compare script angles, and direct an AI video agent in plain language. Keep prompts, video takes, and revisions in one workspace, with credit costs shown before generation.

records.name: TimeCalc
records.tagline: Fast, ad-free date, time, and work hours calculators
records.description: Free date, time, hours, US business days, military time, and Julian date calculators. Instant browser results on any device, with plain-English formulas and examples — no ads, no account, and no cross-site tracking.

records.name: TerminVox
records.tagline: One window for all your terminals and coding agents
records.description: TerminVox puts all your terminals in one window: named groups, tabs and split panes. It marks the terminal where Claude Code or Codex is waiting for you, shows uncommitted git changes, and brings every session back after a restart. Free and open source.

records.name: CLARIOVER
records.tagline: See the Problem. Shape the Solution.
records.description: CLARIOVER helps businesses strengthen their online reputation, improve customer experience, build digital visibility, and streamline operations. From review monitoring and complaint analysis to websites, local SEO, content, quality assurance, and responsible AI-assisted workflows, we deliver practical, human-led support tailored to each business.

records.name: Trove
records.tagline: A Mac app for collecting images, text and links
records.description: Trove is a Mac app for collecting images, text and links into beautiful boards. Everything stays on your computer, in ordinary files you own.

records.name: Chess Prism: Analysis & Review
records.tagline: Free unlimited chess reviews with move-by-move coaching
records.description: Stop guessing why a chess move was good or bad. Chess Prism offers free unlimited game reviews and move-by-move coaching. Import games from Chess.com and Lichess, discover brilliant moves, understand mistakes, practice better alternatives and play against computer opponents. Powered by on-device Stockfish analysis, Chess Prism helps you turn every game into a learning opportunity.

records.name: Good Build
records.tagline: AI WCAG 2.2 accessibility scanner & fixes
records.description: Scan your website against WCAG 2.2 A/AA/AAA, see issues on the page, and get AI-assisted fixes for completely free.

records.name: Marquee
records.tagline: Plex Client for Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac
records.description: Marquee is your Plex library, made for Apple devices. It looks and feels like Apple's TV app, plays in Apple's own video player (Picture in Picture, AirPlay, Siri Remote) with Skip Intro, Skip Credits and Up Next, and at home streams straight from your server at full quality. Plex Home profiles, every server merged into one library, downloads, SharePlay, widgets and Top Shelf. $9.99 once for Apple TV, iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription, no ads.

records.name: Math4ML
records.tagline: Learn the maths behind machine learning by playing with it
records.description: An interactive course that takes you from basic arithmetic to deep learning. 285 lessons with figures you can drag, practice that checks your answers, and games. The 29-lesson beginner course is free forever, with no account, and there is a free calculator for people who test AI models. The nine advanced courses start at £42 a year, with a 7-day trial. In 26 languages.

records.name: AssessDeck
records.tagline: Online Test Maker for Trainers, Educators & Businesses
records.description: Create engaging online tests and assessments with AssessDeck. Build reusable question banks, randomise questions, automate marking and manage learner results. Support six question types, timed assessments and essay grading. Bring your classroom to life with interactive Live Revision sessions where participants answer questions and compete in real time. Free to start, with import and export options that keep you in control of your data.

records.name: Webdesly Air
records.tagline: Fleet, quotes and bookings for brokers and operators
records.description: Quiet aviation desk for brokers and operators: fleet status, route quotes, and bookings to confirm or complete on a Today desk. Not a consumer empty-leg marketplace, not a full travel itinerary tool. Free demo desk, no signup.

records.name: IconJar 3
records.tagline: Every icon you own, in one searchable library on your Mac
records.description: IconJar keeps every icon you own in one library on your Mac. Import SVGs, icon fonts and Lottie files, find any icon in seconds, then recolor and export to any format or code. New in v3: Apple Intelligence tags, icon fonts, a local MCP server, and more…

records.name: Manovella
records.tagline: Product films, written as code, from Claude Code
records.description: Manovella is a Claude Code plugin that makes promo, launch, release and tutorial films of your product, as code. Every frame is a pure function of time: real motion blur from 16 subframes, loops exact to the pixel, your product's UI rebuilt as vector from its source. Brief a film by eye in the Studio, on the real engine, with your music on the beat. Renders stay cool on a third of the cores. Free and MIT-licensed, macOS-first.

records.name: AEGIS Whale Radar
records.tagline: Crypto order flow terminal. Pay once, runs in your browser
records.description: AEGIS Whale Radar shows what candles hide: large trades, sweeps, liquidations and the order book from Binance, Bybit, OKX and Hyperliquid on one screen, with stereo sound and desktop, Telegram or Discord alerts. It runs in your browser on public exchange feeds: no account, no API keys, no monthly fee. One payment, all v4.x updates. Market data only, not financial advice.

records.name: FruitPop
records.tagline: A match-3 with no lives, no timers, no ads, no account
records.description: FruitPop is a juicy match-3 that opens in seconds and plays fully offline. Swipe, match and set off rockets, bombs and two-special combo blasts. Beat levels for up to three stars, take on a Daily Challenge where everyone plays the same board, and relax to generative ambient music that never loops. No lives, no timers, no energy, no ads, no account. Play free in your browser, or on iPhone and Android.

records.name: Bule
records.tagline: Know if you're paying the tourist price, before you pay
records.description: Been quoted a price abroad and no idea if it's fair? Type it into Bule and see in a second if it's fair, high or way over, what to offer instead, and what to say in the local language. Free, no download, works offline. Lombok, Bali, Bangkok and 23 more.

records.name: GalleryLight
records.tagline: GalleryLight is modern and completely private media player.
records.description: GalleryLight is a beautiful, modern, and completely private media player and projector designed for your Android device. Whether you want to watch a video in full screen, view a slideshow of your favorite photos, or need a flashlight to see in the dark, GalleryLight handles it all with a sleek, dark-themed interface. GalleryLight is perfect for presentations, sharing memories, or simply enjoying your media with a clean, distraction-free interface.

records.name: porthole
records.tagline: See which project owns a port and kill it in one keystroke
records.description: porthole shows every port listening on your machine with the project that owns it (from the nearest package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml orgit) and the Docker container behind it. Kill one in a keystroke from an animated TUI, or script it with the CLI. Every kill checks PID and start time first, sends SIGTERM, and uses SIGKILL only if it's ignored. Protected ports, watch mode, an opt-in auto-kill daemon and a local web dashboard. One Go binary for macOS, Linux and Windows. Free, MIT.

records.name: Voella
records.tagline: Daily voice training for people with quiet voices
records.description: Voella is five minutes a day of breathing, voice and speaking practice for people who keep getting asked to repeat themselves. A 30-day plan that adapts to each user, live volume feedback and a weekly recording that makes progress audible. iPhone, no account.

records.name: Nexscope
records.tagline: Ecommerce data & AI creative tools. All in one place.
records.description: Nexscope brings ecommerce, marketing and social data together with AI creative tools. Research products, keywords, competitors and trends. Access data through APIs or connect it to your AI tools via MCP. Create product images, ad creatives, UGC-style videos and product videos—all in one place. Start free with 1,000 trial credits.

records.name: Pixveil: Blur Video & Photo
records.tagline: Blur faces, plates & names before you share, on-device
records.description: Pixveil finds faces, license plates, names in screenshots, phone numbers and IBANs in your photos and videos and hides them in a few taps. Tracking follows faces through video, and you can beep any word from the transcript. Everything runs on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, no watermark.

records.name: Férias Claras
records.tagline: Calculadoras gratuitas de férias, 13º e rescisão
records.description: Calcule quanto você pode receber nas férias, no 13º salário ou na rescisão, com estimativas de descontos e prazos. O Férias Claras reúne calculadoras, guias e ferramentas gratuitas para trabalhadores e empregadores, sem cadastro e com cálculos feitos no navegador.

records.name: Veloce
records.tagline: Rust terminal apps: routes, flexbox, no event loop
records.description: Most Rust terminal libraries stop at drawing cells. Veloce is the application layer above them: a stack router, taffy flexbox snapped to cells, async hydration with cancellation, and a runtime that restores the terminal after a panic or Ctrl-C. The layout cache reuses clean taffy trees: a 2,000-child frame drops from 2.25 ms cold to 160 µs cached. Live frame stats show it. 62 tests, six crates. cargo add veloce-tui. Free and open source.

records.name: VEMMSUNJ
records.tagline: Explore the sky, track satellites and discover dark skies
records.description: VEMMSUNJ brings sky-watching tools together in one place. Explore an interactive 3D Earth globe, track satellites and their orbital paths, explore planetary orbits, check observing conditions and discover observatories and dark-sky locations. Built for curious beginners and experienced sky-watchers.

records.name: Bookybara
records.tagline: Personalized bedtime stories your child reads aloud
records.description: Bookybara writes illustrated bedtime stories starring your child, at their reading level, in English, Turkish, Spanish or German. Kids read along page by page, and parents can see their progress. Free stories to try, on iPhone, iPad and Android.

records.name: Picboop
records.tagline: Free AI photo upscaling, enhancement & editing
records.description: Upscale photos 2× or 4× with AI, reduce noise and compression artefacts, and compare the result with your original. Picboop includes 21 free photo tools, from batch conversion and resizing to background removal and PDF conversion. Drop in your photos, pick a tool, and export without watermarks.

records.name: Zentrix
records.tagline: See how cameras reconstruct colors they never measured
records.description: What if your camera creates colors that aren't there? Zentrix makes the hidden science of digital photography an interactive experience. Learn how color is detected by camera sensors, watch how algorithms reconstruct the missing information, and turn black-and-white patterns into unexpected colors. Experiment with reconstruction algorithms, explore a virtual camera sensor and even try it with your own photos. No technical knowledge needed.

records.name: Livium AI
records.tagline: AI-Native Virtual Staging for Real Estate
records.description: Virtual staging that stays consistent across every angle of a room. Livium reconstructs the room in 3D from your photos using AI, places real furniture models once, and renders every view from that single scene. The result is the same furniture, in the same position, in every shot, unlike tools that generate each photo independently.

records.name: Terrapedia
records.tagline: Travel through world history on a 3D globe
records.description: Terrapedia is a 3D globe of world history. Slide from prehistory to today, watch borders shift, and open any country in any year: an AI-written sheet on its politics, economy, science and culture, with key events, sources and reliability levels. 22 languages.

records.name: Gramina: Focus Timer
records.tagline: Pomodoro that grows a meadow
records.description: Gramina is a focus timer drawn like a plate from an old botanical book. Start a session and a meadow grows up the screen while you work. The grass only grows while you focus, and reaches full height when you complete a session. THREE RHYTHMS • Classic: 25 minutes with a 5 minute break • Focused: 50 minutes with a 10 minute break • Deep work: 90 minutes with a 20 minute break A LIVING MEADOW No two meadows are alike. No account, no subscription, no streaks. 3 grasses free; unlock the rest once.

records.name: QRCodeAlchemy QR Code Generator
records.tagline: Creating QR Codes Online
records.description: QRCodeAlchemy is an AI-powered online QR code generator that helps individuals and businesses create beautiful, customizable, and functional QR codes. It offers AI art QR codes, custom QR designs, dynamic QR codes, image QR codes, bulk generation, and scan analytics. Users can customize colors, patterns, logos, and frames, and export QR codes in multiple formats, including PNG, SVG, and PDF. Whether for marketing, business, restaurants, or personal use

records.name: MyTradeLens
records.tagline: Options trading journal for active traders
records.description: MyTradeLens is a trading journal for options and supported futures prop-firm traders. Import supported history from Schwab, Interactive Brokers, Moomoo, and selected prop-firm platforms, then review performance with notes, setup tags, screenshots, and AI-assisted reviews. 14-day free trial, then $20/month.

records.name: Clear Mark AI
records.tagline: Clear Mark AI – AI Content Watermark Remover for Images  &
records.description: Remove AI content labels, badges and watermarks from images and videos in seconds. ClearMark locates the mark, rebuilds the pixels behind it and hands you a clean file — directly in your browser.

records.name: Insider Ownership
records.tagline: See who's buying and selling — directly in Excel.
records.description: Insider Ownership pulls SEC Form 3 and 4 filings into any spreadsheet with one formula: =INSIDER.OWNERSHIP(ticker). Get a live table of every insider's current stake — name, CIK, share class, direct vs. indirect ownership, last filing date, total shares — or flip to history mode for the full buy/sell trail back to 2006.

records.name: TaskTornado
records.tagline: Free Student Planner & Homework Tracker
records.description: TaskTornado is a free, all-in-one student planner for organizing homework, classes, deadlines, and grades. Plan study sessions, track assignments, and get personalized study help from Aurora AI.
